copy.tagline_60c: Know which beds are empty & collect rent on time
copy.awesome_list_bullet: - [RunMyPG](https://www.runmypg.in) - Open beta PG and hostel management software for Indian property owners.
copy.description_160c: RunMyPG is a free PG & hostel management app for Indian owners to track bed occupancy, collect rent on time via UPI/cash, and record security deposits.
copy.description_500c: RunMyPG is a dedicated property management console built specifically for Indian paying guest (PG) and hostel owners. It replaces messy physical registers and disorganized WhatsApp chats with an inventory-first bed matrix (Room > Bed A, B, C) and predictable monthly rent ledgers. Owners manage tenant move-ins, record direct UPI or cash receipts without gateway fees, track sub-meter electricity readings, and settle security deposits cleanly. Available via web browser and native Android app on the same synchronized account.
key_features: Visual Bed Matrix (Floor > Room > Bed A/B/C occupancy)
Direct UPI & Cash rent recording with zero transaction cuts
One-tap monthly rent ledger (Paid vs Pending)
Native Android rounds app synced with desktop web console
Multi-property switcher for owners running multiple buildings
